name: Octop
description: Self-hosted multi-user AI assistant with agents, IM channels and cron

upstream.$note: Upstream ships no image (no Docker Hub, GHCR package private/absent). We build docker/Dockerfile at tag v1.0.0 in .github/workflows/build.yml and push ghcr.io/hmseeb/octop-railway:1.0.0-r1. One patch in the workflow: the stock entrypoint hardcodes `octop run --host 0.0.0.0` which overrides OCTOP_BIND_HOST (CLI > env > config.json, src/octop/cli/commands/run.py resolve_bind) and is unreachable on Railway's IPv6 private network; the patch makes the flag honor OCTOP_BIND_HOST, default ::.

topology.$note: Single service, single volume. Upstream is one process (FastAPI + uvicorn + APScheduler + agent runtime) with all state under ~/.octop (SQLite WAL default). No web/worker split exists upstream, so the no-shared-volume rule never comes into play. PostgreSQL is optional upstream; deliberately not templated, SQLite on the volume is the upstream default.

octop.startCommandNote: Railway discards the image ENTRYPOINT and execs the start command raw; pointing it at the entrypoint script preserves the first-run bootstrap (octop init, admin creation, credential.txt fallback).

volume.$note: HOME=/data puts ~/.octop on the volume. Holds the SQLite control-plane DB, agent workspaces, uploads, credential.txt.

variables.PORT_note: Railway injects PORT=8080 on image services and healthchecks against it; pinning PORT=8088 keeps the injected var aligned with OCTOP_PORT and the domain target port.
variables.OCTOP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD_note: Entrypoint runs octop init on first boot only (octop.db absent). Password policy is >=8 chars with letters and digits; secret(32) is alphanumeric so it passes, and the entrypoint falls back to a random password written to credential.txt if ever rejected.
variables.OPENAI_API_KEY: prompted, optional; providers can also be configured in the dashboard later

verification.journey: Deploy -> open domain -> login as admin with OCTOP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD -> dashboard loads -> configure provider -> chat with agent
verification.contractTests: test/contract.sh boots the exact image+volume shape and checks health, dashboard HTML, login, JWT, unauth rejection, dual-stack bind, wrong-password rejection
